what: the lecturers' ratings of the gold passages under rater codes, without book text, notes, or names

columns.item_id: identifier of the item in the rating workbooks
columns.track: paired, r2 (rebuilt broad), audit (audited groups of the first broad sample), or p2 (extended paired)
columns.query_id, chunk_id: the question and the gold passage, as in the track's pool
columns.rater_group: statistics or non_statistics, from the book of the passage
columns.S1, S2, N1, N2, N3 _answer: penuh (full answer), sebagian (partial answer), or tidak (no answer); empty when the rater did not rate this group
columns.S1, S2, N1, N2, N3 _clear: whether the rater found the question clear, ya or tidak
columns.settled_answer, settled_clear: the settled label; settled_answer is empty when settled_by is not_settled
columns.settled_by: raters_agreed, n3_median (the median of the answers of N1, N2, and N3), statistics_pair (decided by the statistics raters or a third non-author), or not_settled (penuh against sebagian, both valid)
columns.valid_settled: 1 when the gold counts as valid, that is, a full or partial answer
columns.judge_clear, judge_wording_a, judge_word: the judge model's labels, empty for the paired track, which it did not rate
